ncc_references.relationship: Selection context and generic physical component classes for termite risk management.

objects.name: termite management system
objects.definition: A coordinated set of physical barriers, treated zones, inspection provisions and identification information used to reduce termite entry risk or make concealed entry more difficult.
functions: Reduce the risk of concealed termite entry
Force termite activity into inspectable locations where the selected system relies on detection
Protect susceptible primary building elements as required by the project

cad.pattern: Coordinated component network at termite entry paths
cad.placement: At the slab perimeter, penetrations, joints, suspended-floor supports and vulnerable attachments as selected
cad.opening: Detailed around every applicable service penetration and construction joint

notes: A slab or one barrier component is not automatically a complete system. Selection depends on jurisdiction, site and building construction.

objects.name: termite sheet barrier
objects.definition: A continuous proprietary sheet material installed across likely termite entry paths at slab perimeters, joints, walls or penetrations as part of a tested system.
functions: Block concealed termite passage through the detailed area
Direct termite activity toward an inspectable edge where the system is designed to do so
Join with compatible collars and seals around penetrations

cad.pattern: Continuous detailed sheet zones with sealed joints
cad.placement: At selected termite entry paths in the slab, wall or perimeter construction
cad.opening: Sealed to compatible collars around penetrations

notes: A product must only be modelled as a termite barrier when it belongs to an appropriate tested and installed system.

objects.name: stainless steel mesh termite barrier
objects.definition: A fine corrosion-resistant steel mesh fixed and sealed across joints, perimeters or service penetrations so termites cannot pass through the mesh openings.
functions: Physically block termite passage
Bridge and seal vulnerable construction interfaces
Form collars or strips within a complete management system

cad.pattern: Continuous strips or formed collars at selected entry paths
cad.placement: Embedded or bonded at slab perimeters, joints, walls and penetrations

objects.name: graded stone termite barrier
objects.definition: A compact zone of specially graded hard particles sized and installed so termites cannot readily pass between or move the particles.
functions: Physically obstruct termite passage
Protect selected slab perimeters, penetrations, joints or suspended-floor areas
Form a component of a complete termite management system

cad.pattern: Continuous contained zones at protected entry paths
cad.placement: Around penetrations, along perimeters, within walls or beneath applicable suspended-floor areas

notes: Generic drainage aggregate must not be relabelled as a termite barrier without evidence that it is the specified graded system material.

objects.name: chemical termite treated zone
objects.definition: A defined soil or substrate zone treated with an approved termiticide to reduce termite passage through or activity within that zone.
functions: Create a chemically treated termite-management zone
Protect selected perimeters, under-slab areas or penetrations
Allow replenishment where the system includes reticulation

cad.pattern: Continuous treated zones at selected perimeter or under-slab locations
cad.placement: Within soil beneath or beside protected construction
cad.opening: Extended around protected penetrations where the system requires

notes: The ontology records the physical treated zone, not pesticide selection or application instructions.

objects.name: termite shield
objects.definition: A formed metal sheet placed over a stump, pier or wall support to obstruct concealed termite passage and expose any shelter tubes around its projecting edges.
functions: Interrupt concealed termite access over a support
Force termite shelter tubes into a more visible path
Separate susceptible framing from the support below

cad.pattern: One at each applicable stump or pier head
cad.placement: Between the support head and the bearer or supported framing
cad.opening: Detailed around any hold-down rod or fixing
cad.load: Inspection-forcing barrier sheet; bearing depends on support detail

notes: Despite the trade name 'ant cap', its termite-management role is to obstruct concealed access and aid inspection rather than guarantee exclusion by itself.

objects.name: termite penetration collar
objects.definition: A rigid or flexible barrier component fitted tightly around a service passing through a slab or other protected construction to close a termite entry path.
functions: Seal the termite-management system around a service penetration
Connect the penetration detail to the surrounding barrier or slab
Prevent concealed passage beside the service

cad.pattern: One at each applicable service penetration
cad.placement: Tightly around the service at the protected slab or barrier plane
cad.opening: Surrounds and seals the service penetration

notes: Similar-looking collars used for moisture or fire have different tested functions and must remain separate object roles.

objects.name: termite treatment reticulation pipe
objects.definition: A perforated pipe network installed in a treatment zone so termiticide can be introduced or replenished without reopening the protected construction.
functions: Distribute termiticide through a selected soil zone
Allow future replenishment of a chemical termite-management component
Connect treatment zones to accessible charging points

cad.pattern: Looped or zoned perforated runs to the proprietary system layout
cad.placement: Within the chemical-treated soil zone beneath or beside protected construction
cad.opening: Routes around footings and service penetrations to the system design

notes: Detailed system layout and chemical compatibility are proprietary design information.

objects.name: termite management durable notice
objects.definition: A permanently fixed identification notice recording the installed termite management system and information needed for later inspection or maintenance.
functions: Identify the installed termite management system
Record installation and maintenance information
Provide enduring information to owners, inspectors and trades

cad.pattern: One durable notice per installed system or as required
cad.placement: Permanently fixed in a prominent accessible location such as the meter box

notes: The notice is a physical object; the information printed on it is object metadata, not a building member.
